title: Oracle Kicks Off $20 Billion Capital Raise
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down debt offerings from Oracle, which is kicking off a $20 billion capital raise to finance its AI infrastructure spending, and Alphabet, which is tapping the European debt markets. Plus, Anthropic's revenue hits nearly $17 billion in the third quarter and Matt Witheiler, head of late-stage growth at Wellington and an Anthropic investor, joins to discuss new details from the amended IPO filing.  And Apple is trading at its priciest level since 2008, ahead of its earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Will Create 'Weird' Economic Benefits: Manidis
summary: A new essay called "The Commanding Heights" argues that as artificial intelligence becomes cheaper and more widely available, the biggest economic gains will ultimately flow to the companies best at diffusing AI into the real world. Will Manidis, co-author of the essay and SVP of Veradigm AI, discusses what he sees as the market’s mispricing of AI’s benefits and why the creators of the technology aren't always its biggest winners. Manidis joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mendler's Northwood Reaches $2 Billion Valuation
summary: Aerospace startup Northwood raises $375 million at a $2 billion valuation to expand its production and deployment of the ground infrastructure needed by the space industry. CEO Bridgit Mendler speaks with Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." She joins from Northwood's new 185,000-square-foot factory.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic to Spend $895 Billion in the Years Ahead
summary: Ahead of its blockbuster public market debut, Anthropic revealed it plans to spend more than $895 billion in the years ahead. The Claude chatbot maker also disclosed that its quarterly revenue rose twelve-fold over from the prior year. Matt Witheiler,  head of late-stage growth at Wellington Management and an investor in Anthropic, discusses the latest figures and why developing frontier models is a pathway to outsized returns. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Qatalyst Notches Its Biggest Deal With Rare Buyside M&A Role
summary: Qatalyst Partners, the boutique investment bank serving the tech industry, has just landed its biggest-ever deal after diverting from its normal focus on selling companies.

title: Why GTA VI Makes the Case for AI in Gaming
summary: As development costs soar, studios face growing financial risks and fewer opportunities to experiment. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Gearoid Reidy says AI could make game development cheaper and help revive creativity across the industry. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple’s $1 Trillion Rally Leaves No Room for Error on Earnings
summary: The runup in Apple Inc. shares in recent months has left the iPhone maker little room for disappointment when it reports earnings after the bell on Monday.

title: Supermarkets Across Europe Report Suspected Freezer Hack
summary: Supermarkets across Europe were hit by suspected cyberattacks that caused sudden changes in the temperatures of their fridges and freezers, weeks after a similar issue in France. Charlotte Hughes-Morgan explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Eyes at Least $20 Billion From Potential Bond Offerings
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is eyeing at least $20 billion from a potential cross-border investment-grade bond offering as the tech giant gauges investor interest in its debt amid growing skepticism about the pace of spending on artificial intelligence.

title: Apple’s Valuation Premium Confronts AI Jitters
summary: The runup in Apple shares in recent months has left the iPhone maker little room for disappointment when it reports earnings after the bell on Monday. The gains have left the stock trading at the priciest levels since 2008, making it particularly vulnerable if the company’s results fall short of expectations. At roughly 36 times earnings expected over the next 12 months, the shares are almost twice as expensive as the S&P 500 Index, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. We preview Apple's results with Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DeepSeek Boosts AI Agent Offering With New Creator Mode
summary: DeepSeek has unveiled a new option to quickly create custom plugins that help users to tackle a range of complex tasks, the latest move by the Chinese lab to bolster its AI agent offerings.

title: Supermarkets in Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Finland Hit by Suspected Freezer Hack
summary: Supermarkets across Europe were hit by suspected cyberattacks that resulted in sudden changes in the temperatures of their fridges and freezers on Monday, echoing a more widespread problem in France last month.

title: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in Historic $115 Billion Tech Deal
summary: Marvell Technology Inc. agreed to buy Lumentum Holdings Inc. at an enterprise value of $115 billion, clinching one of the largest technology deals in history in a push to capitalize on runaway data center spending.

title: NYC Comptroller Steps Up Criticism of Anthropic After IPO Filing
summary: Anthropic PBC’s approach to its planned initial public offering threatens to disempower shareholders and prevent ordinary people from reining in a potentially dangerous form of technology, according to New York City’s comptroller.

title: Binance Boosts Market Maker Incentives in Wake of Record Hack
summary: Binance has increased the incentives it offers some market makers to trade on its platform, as the world’s largest crypto exchange seeks to bolster activity on its venue after suffering a record $6.3 billion hack.

title: Anthropic Commits to $895 Billion in Spending as Mega-IPO Nears
summary: Anthropic PBC disclosed a twelve-fold increase in quarterly revenue while revealing that it intends to spend more than $895 billion in the years ahead, as the artificial intelligence lab courts investors for a potentially-record-breaking IPO.

title: Binance Outflows Reach $4.7 Billion After North Korea Hack
summary: Binance has experienced $4.7 billion in net outflows since the crypto-exchange giant reinstated withdrawals following a historic hack, a figure that’s grown but is still a small portion of overall assets on the platform.

title: Anthropic Revenue Hits Nearly $17 Billion Before Mega-IPO
summary:
Anthropic PBC reported third-quarter revenue of nearly $17 billion as of Sept. 30, a twelve-fold increase versus the same period a year ago that’s set to stoke anticipation for the artificial intelligence lab’s potentially record-breaking IPO. 
Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head of Tech Research, Mandeep Singh discusses the report and looks ahead to the company's public trading debut. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Marvell to Buy Lumentum in $115 Billion Deal
summary: Marvell Technology Inc. has reached a deal to buy Lumentum Holdings Inc. at an enterprise value of $115 billion.  Paul Sweeney breaks down the deal on Bloomberg Radio. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russia Allows Use of Foreign Data Centers in Wake of Attacks
summary: Russia will temporarily allow the use of data centers outside of its borders after a series of Ukrainian attacks that targeted tech giant Yandex’s facilities.
